summary: Gravy Deco is an album by Robyn Hitchcock, released during a period of intense re-issuing of his work in the mid-1990s. Its title reflects the material's history: it first surfaced in the early 1980s as "Groovy Decay" and was later substantially remixed as "Groovy Decoy". The note is brief and gives no track listing or other details.
one_line: Gravy Deco is a mid-1990s Robyn Hitchcock album compiling the early-1980s "Groovy Decay" and remixed "Groovy Decoy" sessions.
key_facts: Gravy Deco (The Complete Groovy Decay/Decoy Sessions) is an album by Robyn Hitchcock.
The album was issued during a spell of intense re-issuing of Robyn Hitchcock's work in the mid-1990s.
The album's material surfaced in the early 1980s.
The material first appeared under the title "Groovy Decay".
The material was later substantially remixed and released as "Groovy Decoy".
The album's full subtitle is "The Complete Groovy Decay/Decoy Sessions".
